$comment: What the scout role (epoch 3 E3 s1) returns: ONE JSON object. The scout is read-only (Read, Glob, Grep) and writes nothing. Arm `ok` carries the facts it found, each with 1 to 5 pieces of evidence, the repository files a reader of the task needs, and what it looked for and did not find; arm `refused` carries a reason. An evidence item is {file, line, text}: coai runs the check ITSELF — the file must be inside the repository and the line must hold the text once white space is collapsed; a text that is empty or only white space is an error (it is judged before any line is read, so it can never be verified), and so is a path that is absolute, has a drive or `..`, runs through a link, is a `.git` path or is named like a credential file. coai builds the envelope of result.json from the answer and the check; a model's `verified` is never read (and an unknown key is an error). The limits are the tables of src_mcp/core/Roles/ScoutOutput.cs; neither half of the product has a JSON Schema engine, so coai-mcp reads this shape with its own strict reader and AScoutContractTests holds the file and the reader equal.
title: coai scout output
